hypotheses.M0_factor_vjps_recompose_native_attentio: QK1, QK2, and value VJPs sum to the native local attention VJP with maximum relative error at most 1e-5, and the all-block recurrence matches direct gradients.
hypotheses.M1_full_early_factor_program_replicates: All three factors in Blocks 2 through 9 reach median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.M2_qk_routing_alone_is_sufficient: QK1 plus QK2 in Blocks 2 through 9 reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.M3_value_transport_alone_is_sufficient: The value derivative in Blocks 2 through 9 reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.M4_routing_value_complementarity_is_mate: The full early program beats the better of QK-only and value-only by at least 0.05 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.M5_two_qk_factors_are_complementary: QK1 plus QK2 beats the better individual QK factor by at least 0.05 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.M6_one_qk_factor_plus_value_is_sufficien: At least one QK-factor-plus-value program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
